relations: The right cumulus summit lowers and rounds out, opening a bright backlit gap at its top.
As the right cloud edge evolves, the upper-left crepuscular rays subtly shift in angle and intensity.
The lower shadowed cloud bank's rim highlights undergo minor gradual evolution without significant horizontal drift.
The camera and diagonal power lines remain fixed relative to the frame edges during the light evolution.
caption: The video captures a fixed outdoor view of a bright blue sky dominated by a large backlit cumulus cloud on the right, the sun hidden so that crepuscular rays fan toward the upper left. A shadowed cloud bank fills the lower frame, two thin power lines run diagonally across the lower third, and a touch of foliage sits at the corner. The camera and power lines remain steady relative to the frame edges. The summit of the right-hand cloud slowly reshapes, its pointed tower lowering and rounding out, and a bright backlit gap opens at the top, changing the silhouette with little horizontal translation. The fan of rays subtly shifts in angle and intensity as the cloud edge evolves, the leftmost bands repositioning slightly. Small wisps and rim highlights on the lower bank undergo minor, gradual evolution, with little overall drift of the cloud masses. The visible motion is cloud and light evolution rather than obvious camera movement.
